scope: Historical upstream review of file/process boundaries, release contents and dependency licenses; not a review or security guarantee for this fork.
forkChanges: macOS only; app updater, credential services and other platform support removed. This fork has not received a new release security audit.
excluded: Personal home paths and builder identity
dependencyDelivery: Large media and Office runtimes are acquired directly from upstream with pinned hashes; included libraries/source retain license notices.
knownLimits: Source builds use ad-hoc signing by default, without Apple notarization.
Complex media/document parsers and external upstream dependencies remain attack surfaces.
Public URL downloads depend on the remote site and do not import browser cookies.
